summary.name: Loudly
summary.one_liner: Loudly is an AI music platform for generating, remixing, mastering, stem-splitting and distributing songs, with an API for platforms.
use_cases: create full songs with AI vocals and lyrics
split songs into stems for remixing or sampling
build background music or sync licensed tracks
embed music generation into a developer product
summary.what_it_does: Loudly offers several AI music models: VEGA 1 for fast rough drafts, VEGA 2 for production-oriented background music, VEGA 3 for finished instrumentals, and MANTA 1 for full songs with lyrics and vocals. It also integrates partner model Stability 2.5 for sample generation. SongDNA analyzes an uploaded track's audio, lyrics, structure, mood, tempo and key to produce a reusable fingerprint that feeds prompts, playlist pitches, captions and video prompts. The AI Remix Engine rebuilds new versions of songs the user owns and exports remix-ready assets. Other features include genre-aware AI mastering aimed at streaming loudness targets, stem separation into WAV or MP3, and built-in distribution to 50+ platforms.
notable: Multiple generation models including VEGA 1/2/3 and MANTA 1 for vocal songs
SongDNA structured song fingerprint used as context for agent actions
Generation, mastering, stem splitting and distribution in one workflow
caveats: Page says the free tier for trying all models requires no credit card, but full terms of paid tiers are not stated on the page
Pricing details, model-specific limits and distribution fees are not given in the page text
